title: Online Shopping Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk when shopping online. Assess tracking exposure, payment security, and get personalized tips for safer shopping.
description: Evaluate your online shopping privacy risks based on your browsing habits, payment methods, and security practices. Get personalized recommendations to protect your data and avoid dynamic pricing while shopping online.

formula: const weights = { shoppingFrequency: 15, trackerBlocking: 25, cookieManagement: 20, incognitoUsage: 15, paymentMethods: 15, accountCreation: 5, priceComparison: 5 }; const scores = { shoppingFrequency: { daily: 100, weekly: 75, monthly: 40, rarely: 10 }, trackerBlocking: { strict: 10, standard: 40, none: 90, unsure: 70 }, cookieManagement: { always: 10, sometimes: 50, never: 100 }, incognitoUsage: { always: 10, often: 30, sometimes: 60, never: 100 }, paymentMethods: { 'virtual-cards': 10, 'paypal-apple': 40, 'direct-card': 70, 'stored-cards': 100 }, accountCreation: { guest: 20, minimal: 50, always: 100 }, priceComparison: { 'private-tools': 20, 'different-devices': 40, 'same-browser': 100 } }; let totalScore = 0; for (let key in weights) { totalScore += (scores[key][inputs[key]] * weights[key]) / 100; } const privacyRisk = Math.round(totalScore); const trackingExposure = Math.round(totalScore * 0.8 + (inputs.shoppingFrequency === 'daily' ? 20: 0)); const riskGrade = privacyRisk <= 25 ? 'A': privacyRisk <= 40 ? 'B': privacyRisk <= 60 ? 'C': privacyRisk <= 80 ? 'D': 'F'; return { privacyRisk, riskGrade, trackingExposure };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your online shopping privacy risk based on your browser's tracker blocking, cookie habits, private browsing, payment methods, and shopping habits. Higher scores indicate greater privacy risks including data collection, dynamic pricing exposure, and financial information vulnerability.
tips: Turn on strict tracker blocking in your browser, or use one that blocks trackers by default
Shop in a private window so the shop can't link the visit to your cookies and browsing history
Use virtual credit cards or services like Apple Pay to protect your real payment information
Clear cookies between shopping sessions or use separate browsers for different retailers
Compare prices using private browsing or different devices to see true pricing

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy practices. You're well-protected from tracking and price manipulation.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy habits with room for improvement. Consider stricter tracker blocking or virtual cards.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy vulnerabilities. You may experience dynamic pricing and moderate tracking.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy exposure. Your shopping data is likely being collected and analyzed.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Major privacy vulnerabilities. You're highly exposed to tracking, data collection, and price manipulation.
